subject: Thank you for applying to Peachtree Brands
body:
Hi Jordan,

Thank you for applying to the Marketing Intern position at Peachtree Brands. We have received your application and our recruiting team will review it carefully.

If your qualifications match our needs, a member of our team will reach out to schedule an interview. In the meantime, follow our brand stories on Instagram.

Best,
Peachtree Brands Talent Team
